archetype: Commander-reliant Naya Dinosaur battlecruiser: one engine (Gishath's combat-damage reveal, verified in stack 001), three command-zone cost reducers as its ignition, a per-Dinosaur-entry draw layer that pays the reveal back, and a two-card enrage residue that survives as the payoff side of one verified one-sided sweep (stack 004). strategic_frame.json and engine.json both say RELIANT, not built around, and the audit applies base targets with no archetype override, so every count is a starting point.
verdict: It functions and it converts once it connects: turn-3 land drop 0.894, ramp assembled 0.964, the modelled reveal fires 1.953 times a game for 4.096 free Dinosaurs, kill by turn 8 is 0.617 against nothing, and Forge v1.1.0 at standard-v3 reads 15 of 36 decided, 0.417 [0.271, 0.578], on a table whose null is 0.317. What limits it is WHEN: Gishath is cast by turn 6 in 25.5% of goldfish games (median 7, never by turn 10 in 23.0%), Forge first resolves him at mean global turn 31.47 (round 8); paired game by game in the v1.1.0 record, the 16 games in which he resolved and the seat was still eliminated show a median gap of 5.5 global turns from his resolution to the elimination (mean 8.75, min 2, max 26 — about a round and a half), and 8 of the 24 eliminations came before he ever resolved. Before he lands the deck's own output is 13.8 mean / 7.5 median cumulative combat damage by round 8. The levers on that turn are mana, which the deck already spends fifteen slots on, and three named reducers at 7.1% of an opener each — dragged by colour (W 0.481 / R 0.515 on curve from lands alone) and by three non-discounting eight-plus drops competing for one cast. The six check-in swaps did not measurably move the Forge rate: +0.0738 on 12/35 to 15/36, Newcombe interval [-0.1465, 0.2839] (stats.diff_proportions), against a minimum detectable difference of 0.32 at the decided 36 and 35 (stats.mde_proportion).

single_points_of_failure.component: Gishath, Sun's Avatar — the cast turn, not the card
single_points_of_failure.why: The deck's ENGINE waits on him: the reveal (stack 001) is what goldfish_targets.json and engine.json declare the deck around, and the verified lines and the RELIANT framing run through it. The conversion layer does not. By oracle text (cards.json) the repeatable entry triggers in the 99 are Pantlaza (any Dinosaur, once each turn), Garruk's Uprising and Vaultborn Tyrant (any creature with power 4 or greater, which 22 of the deck's 30 Dinosaur creatures are) and Selvala (an entrant whose power beats every other creature's, for whoever controls it); Earthshaker Dreadmaw scales with the Dinosaurs already there but triggers only on its own entry, Regisaur Alpha only on its own, Descendants' Path is an upkeep trigger off a Dinosaur already on the board, and Curious Altisaur draws off combat damage, not entry. None of those waits on Gishath, which is how the goldfish reaches kill by turn 8 0.617 while he is cast by turn 8 in 57.1% of games, and in Forge v1.1.0 commander damage dealt is 9.22 mean against 75.0 mean combat damage to players. He is never missing, only late — median turn 7 in the goldfish; in Forge v1.1.0 he resolved in 32 of 40 games, and paired per game the median gap from his resolution to the seat's elimination is 5.5 global turns (16 games with both; 8 eliminations came before he resolved). Before that turn the deck's measured output is 13.8 mean / 7.5 median cumulative combat damage by round 8 (v1.1.0), and every return trip costs {2} more.

open_questions.question: Marauding Raptor's entry ping into a reveal of four Dinosaurs including Trapjaw Tyrant and Wrathful Raptors: four separate triggers, four exiles, and does the redirected damage go anywhere useful?
open_questions.why_it_matters: The add is priced as both a reducer and the residue's missing damage source; only the first half is oracle-text certain.

open_questions.question: Chandra's Ignition on a 7-power Gishath with Temple Altisaur down: one-sided, and what does Wrathful Raptors do with the 1 each Dinosaur takes?
open_questions.why_it_matters: The cart holds it as Austere Command's replacement; if it is one-sided through Altisaur it is a second copy of the deck's thinnest verified line.

open_questions.question: Split 'Cost reducer or cheat-into-play drawn' into a three-card 'Command-zone discount drawn' group (Otepec Huntmaster, Urza's Incubator, Knight of the Stampede) and add Vaultborn Tyrant and Earthshaker Dreadmaw to the payoff group, then re-run.
open_questions.why_it_matters: The ignition rate — the axis this diagnosis says binds — is not a measured number today; the seven-card group reads 0.81 for a question it half-answers.

open_questions.question: Is there a construction school for commander-RELIANT decks — mulligan discipline, protection sizing and pivot timing when the commander is the only engine — and for typal lands whose mana pays spells but not abilities?
open_questions.why_it_matters: strategy:deckbuilding.archetype-selection draws the line in one sentence; the reducer-class sizing in this diagnosis is arithmetic with no citation behind it.

gaps: No deck_recon.json exists (audit freshness.recon present: false), so no inclusion-rate evidence supports any add; every candidate here is corpus-sourced through card-search. MODE recon would settle which of them strong Gishath lists actually run.

Forge N is 40 games per record. The v1.1.0 rate 15/36 = 0.417 [0.271, 0.578] against a table null of 0.317; the minimum detectable difference from a 0.343 base is 0.305 at N=40 per arm (stats.mde_proportion: rate_b 0.648, power 0.808) and 0.32 at the decided 36 and 35 (rate_b 0.663, power 0.801), and the V3-to-v1.1.0 change of +0.0738 (12/35 to 15/36) has a Newcombe interval of [-0.1465, 0.2839] (stats.diff_proportions) — the six check-in swaps produced no measurable change. The cart branch has no Forge run at all.

Card advantage is mostly invisible to the goldfish: 2 of 8 draw cards modelled, six named in draw_not_modelled (Curious Altisaur, Hunter's Insight, Jetmir's Garden, Runic Armasaur, Selvala, Vaultborn Tyrant). The 1.353 extra cards by turn 8 is a floor.
The Forge AI held Hunter's Insight (80 games) and Beast Within (40) all game; their value at a human-piloted table is unmeasured, and both cuts above are priced as floors for that reason.

The captain's log is one game on the V3 list. Its open question — Enlarge finished a game the tracked 99 could not hold — is closed by the check-in (Enlarge is in v1.1.0); nothing else in it is yet a pattern.

The ramp axis counts Blasphemous Act as ramp:cost-reduction and files Skyshroud Claim under tutors; the 'over' verdict is right by coincidence and should not be read as slack to cut without enumerating.

No V3-versus-v1.1.0 engine-cast comparison is meaningful at this N: Knight of the Stampede (cast 8), Enlarge (8), Sunfrill Imitator (8, activated 2), Kinjalli's Sunwing (5), Earthshaker Dreadmaw (5) and Runic Armasaur (4) were all cast, so none of the six new cards was held — which is all the record can say about them.

findings.note: Repair (1) verified against cards.json oracle text. A sweep of every nonland entry whose text contains 'enters' finds exactly four repeatable entry triggers: Pantlaza ('Whenever Pantlaza or another Dinosaur you control enters ... Do this only once each turn'), Garruk's Uprising ('Whenever a creature you control with power 4 or greater enters, draw a card'), Vaultborn Tyrant ('Whenever this creature or another creature you control with power 4 or greater enters'), Selvala ('Whenever another creature enters, its controller may draw a card if its power is greater than each other creature's power'). Every other 'enters' is the card's own entry (Dreadmaw, Regisaur Alpha, Bronzebeak Foragers, Regal Behemoth, Topiary Stomper, Trumpeting Carnosaur, Wakening Sun's Avatar, Zacama, Itzquinth, Huatli) or an 'as this enters' choice (Belbe's Portal, Urza's Incubator). Earthshaker Dreadmaw is 'When this creature enters, draw a card for each other Dinosaur you control' — scaled by the board, fired once on its own entry, as the doctor now says. Descendants' Path ('At the beginning of your upkeep ... shares a creature type with a creature you control') and Curious Altisaur ('deals combat damage to a player') are stated for what they are. '22 of the deck's 30 Dinosaur creatures' enumerates: 30 Dinosaur creature entries including the commander, 22 at printed power >= 4, the eight under it Bronzebeak Foragers, Curious Altisaur, Itzquinth, Kinjalli's Sunwing, Runic Armasaur, Sunfrill Imitator, Temple Altisaur, Thrashing Brontodon. The figures carried over reproduce from the 7a29734e record: commander_damage.dealt_total.mean 9.22, combat_damage_dealt_to_players.mean 75.0, resolved 32/40, 16 paired games median 5.5, 8 pre-resolution eliminations. All three quotes are verbatim in lookup-strategy and used in the section's own sense ('built around your commander is not reliant on it' / 'hands three opponents one target' sit in one sentence of archetype-selection; the {2} tax line is commander-insurance's recast-tax pricing).

Repair (2) verified. Recomputed from games[].per_seat.gishath of sythis-enchantress-vs-jarad-graveyard-vs-abaddon-n40-7a29734e (commander_resolved_turn vs eliminated_turn): 16 games carry both, gaps [2,3,3,3,3,3,5,5,6,10,12,13,15,15,16,26], median 5.5, mean 8.75, min 2, max 26; 24 eliminations, 8 with no resolved turn; 32 resolved; 15 wins. 'About a round and a half' is 5.5 global turns at four seats. The unpaired 'one round before the table kills it' inference is gone and the surrounding figures (31.47 / 29 / 18; 35.75 n 24 ci95 [31.94, 39.56]; 0.80 [0.652, 0.895]; 0.255 / 7 / 7.362 / 2,299) are the same text I verified in iteration 2.

Repair (3) verified. cards.json power >= 9 is exactly Ghalta, Primal Hunger 12/12 ({10}{G}{G}, 'costs {X} less ... total power of creatures you control'), Ghalta and Mavren 12/12 ({3}{G}{G}{W}{W} = seven), Zacama 9/9; Gishath is 7. The token clause is quoted to sense ('X is the greatest power among other attacking creatures'), so beside its parent it is 12 with Ghalta cut or not. {G}{G} at ten total power is the printed reduction; Gishath 7 plus one Dinosaur of power 3 reaches it, as 'one Dinosaur past the reveal' says. Enlarge is in the 99 ('+7/+7 and gains trample'), 5 + 7 = 12. engine_casts.by_card: v1.1.0 Ghalta cast 1 / discarded 5, V3 (432faa65) cast 10 / discarded 4. 'only ~1.5 cards at mana value 8+' is verbatim in strategy:deckbuilding.curve's MtGDS paragraph. The cut is now priced as the {G}{G} tempo rather than as a body the deck would lose, which is the cost.

The residual the doctor flagged, judged by the same oracle text: 'Vaultborn Tyrant and Earthshaker Dreadmaw are per-Dinosaur-entry draws by oracle text'. cards.json: Earthshaker Dreadmaw is 'When this creature enters, draw a card for each other Dinosaur you control' — one trigger on its own entry, scaled by the Dinosaurs already there, not a draw per Dinosaur entering; Vaultborn Tyrant triggers on 'another creature you control with power 4 or greater', which is 22 of the 30 Dinosaurs and not the other eight. The sentence now contradicts the artifact's own single_points_of_failure[0], which states Dreadmaw 'triggers only on its own entry'. The count survives: the audit's card-advantage probe lists both cards as drawing without a draw:* role, so 'the true class is eight' stands as a payoff class; only the mechanism clause is wrong. One-sentence fix, in a field the doctor was not scoped to touch — the orchestrator widens scope. I marked this field supported in iteration 2 and was wrong then for the same reason as finding 3 of that pass.

Differs from the reconstructed iteration-2 text in one clause outside the three declared repairs: 'the only lever on that turn is three named reducers' became 'The levers on that turn are mana, which the deck already spends fifteen slots on, and three named reducers'. deck-audit ramp axis value 15 copies (rock / dork / ritual / land / cost-reduction / treasure), so the figure is the audit's and the superlative is re-scoped rather than added. Every other figure in the verdict is the iteration-2 text I verified then (0.894, 0.964, 1.953, 4.096, 0.617, 15/36 0.417 [0.271, 0.578], null 0.317, 25.5% / 7 / 23.0%, 31.47, 5.5 / 8.75 / 2 / 26, 8 of 24, 13.8 / 7.5, 0.481 / 0.515, +0.0738 [-0.1465, 0.2839], MDE 0.32).

Also differs from the reconstruction: 'eliminated 10 of 24 times' became 'accounts for 10 of the 19 attributed eliminations of this seat in Forge v1.1.0 (24 in all); the graveyard seat for two'. Record 7a29734e per_seat.gishath.eliminated_by: 24 eliminations, 5 unattributed, sythis-enchantress seats 4 + 3 + 2 + 1 = 10, jarad-graveyard 1 + 1 = 2, abaddon 2 + 3 + 2 = 7. lean_into[3].why carries the same '10 of 19 attributed' and verifies identically.

Differs from the reconstruction in naming what mana_analysis does not count. mana_analysis.sources.producers with R: Arcane Signet, Boros Signet, Huatli — three, and sources.nonland.R = 3. Selvala ('Add X mana in any combination of colors'), Regal Behemoth ('add an additional one mana of any color' while monarch) and Bonehoard Dracosaur ('create a Treasure token') are in cards.json, can make R, and are absent from producers; the audit's mana-sources note says 'rituals and Treasure makers are one-shot and are not counted'. R 21 -> 20 follows.

Differs from the reconstruction: 'The only ramp piece that puts a land in hand' became 'One of two ... (Huatli's entry is the other)'. Oracle sweep for library-search-to-hand of a land: Huatli ('search your library for a basic land card, reveal it, put it into your hand') and Kodama's Reach ('put one onto the battlefield tapped and the other into your hand') — exactly two. goldfish_metrics land_drop_hit_rate_by_turn 5 = 0.624, 6 = 0.555; 'Ramp or fixing drawn' assembled_rate 0.964.

Differs from the reconstruction in how the superlative is scoped: 'The deck's only wipe that is one-sided by creature type from hand'. Oracle sweep for destroy-all / damage-to-each-creature / exile-all in the 99: Austere Command (by mana value / permanent type), Blasphemous Act (13 to each creature; one-sided only through Temple Altisaur's 'prevent all but 1' on other Dinosaurs), Wakening Sun's Avatar ('destroy all non-Dinosaur creatures' if cast from hand) — three, and the claim is true of the set. 'Sweepers go 2 to 1, still inside the 1–3 target' is the audit's sweepers axis (value 2: Austere Command, Wakening Sun's Avatar; target 1–3).

Differs from the reconstruction: 'The one engine in this list's reach that needs no board and no connection' became 'keys on casting, not on a creature board or a connection — which every other draw effect in the 99 except Jetmir's Garden's cycling requires'. Oracle sweep of 'draw' in the 99: Curious Altisaur and Hunter's Insight need a connection; Garruk's Uprising, Rishkar's Expertise, Selvala, Vaultborn Tyrant, Earthshaker Dreadmaw need a creature (of power) on the board or entering; Runic Armasaur must itself be on the board and needs an opponent's activation; Jetmir's Garden cycles from hand. The re-scoped claim holds.

Differs from the reconstruction by one figure: 30 -> '29 Dinosaur creature entries in the 99'. cards.json: 30 Dinosaur creature entries including the commander, 29 in the 99. lean_into[0].why's added '29 of 33 with the commander out of the library' is the same enumeration (34 creature entries, 30 Dinosaurs).
